description:
The Japanese yen plunged to its weakest level in nearly 40 years, and Wall Street believed the trade was unstoppable.

Then everything changed.

A leaked note from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested the U.S. was preparing to buy billions of yen alongside Japan. Within hours, one of the world's biggest carry trades began to unwind, forcing short sellers into a massive squeeze.

Was this a coordinated U.S.–Japan rescue, or just the beginning of a much larger financial battle?

#Japan #Yen #Trump #ScottBessent #WallStreet #Finance #USDJPY #Markets #Economy #ChinaInsights
title: Japan's Last Stand: Trump's Secret Move Crushes $1 Trillion Yen Short Sellers

description:
Elon Musk says that by 2036, money may no longer matter. At the same time, reports suggest Tesla is quietly preparing to reduce its dependence on China—even as Musk publicly denies any plan to split its China business.

Are these two stories connected?

In this episode, we examine Tesla's supply-chain shift, SpaceX's growing national security role, Musk's vision of an AI-powered post-money society, and why China may be at the center of his biggest strategic decision yet.
